body:
Part of #1720.

## Review brief
This change adds optional row-driven Debug controls to the shared ScreenMap session chip. It adds recorded runs to Trace and SQL and adds a Steps pane with stack, source windows, locals and watch values. Check the approved fixture review on Storybook and the frontend gate receipt below. The main risk is integration with live recorder answers; live proof and full TD19 coverage remain pending, so this change is not ready to merge.

## UI review
Owner approved the preview direction through firstmate inbox 004, with three text fixes now applied: separate armed and not-armed counts, external-frame location text, and a Rows label on database calls.
Reference: recorded step-through `lib/vsdbg/session.tpl.html` from dms-workspaces, as issue 1720 requires. No new prototype or third-party source.
Story: http://100.88.10.58:5010/?path=/story/components-screen-debug--profile-maintenance&full=1&statuses=new;modified
Primitives: Button, Badge, Switch, Popover, Select, Label; existing CodeViewer. Component: CFW.ScreenMap in release-units/screen-map, unchanged version and peers. Existing dock slots contain Trace, SQL and Steps. Business words and rows are page/fixture data.

## Proof
`frontend gate: cases=36 passed=36 failed=0 cached=1 capabilities=node,chromium,package-build,client-build,npm-archive,release-publication omitted=typescript,client-production-build,lint seconds=247.6 result=PASS`
TypeScript release-unit check passed. Preview DOM widths were 1440/1440 and 390/390. No screenshots or dealer recordings are attached to GitHub.

## Remaining work — do not merge yet
- Full red-first TD19 cases for last-answer selection, Steps source windows and cut labels.
- Exact responsive reference layout and source links; automatic Steps opening and handler selection coverage.
- Page-row writes and real home runs only after deployment; Tester's acceptance record and firstmate approval.
- TD15 company registration and TD16 cleanup proof.
